prompt:
1. 한 남자가 길을 걷다가 바닥에 개미를 발견하고 발로 밟는다. 그러자 개미가 거대하게 커지면서 남자가 뒤로 넘어진다.
2. 개미가 커지면서 남자가 엄청 작아졌다. 남자는 하늘을 바라보니 사람들이 거인과도 같이 걸어다니는게 보인다.
3. 남자에게 바퀴벌레 한마리가 쫒아오고 남자는 미친듯이 도망친다.
4. 도망치다가 길을 건너는데 자동차들이 아슬아슬 밟힐듯이 지나가는것을 겨우 통과한다.
5. 그때 바람에 날려 붕 날아가다가 벌위에 앉는다. 벌의 등에타고 도시를 날아다니는 장면은 1인칭 시점으로 도시 여행.
6. 그러다가 벌집에 들어가서 꿀먹고 맛이 좋다는 표정을 지으면서 끝.

environment.overview: A contemporary masonry city combines pale concrete, charcoal asphalt, weathered mid-gray brick, dark metal, and softly translucent gray wax, with clear daylight giving every surface a sharply readable texture.
environment.location_type: An outdoor city sidewalk, road crossing, and airborne route ending inside a natural hive in a rooftop wall.

zones.name: Paving Strip
zones.description: Broad concrete paving slabs, deep joints containing grit, a few grass blades, a raised curb, brick storefront bases, recessed doorways, and the lower portions of metal window frames

zones.name: Tire Crossing
zones.description: Charcoal road pavement, worn pale crossing stripes, loose grit, the sidewalk curb at the departure edge, the opposite curb, and the brick building fronts bordering the road

zones.name: Rooftop Approach
zones.description: Open air above the crossing, the crossing itself visible below, rows of brick facades, projecting window ledges, flat roofs, metal vents, distant taller buildings, clear sky, and a nearby brick parapet containing a narrow dark hive entrance

zones.name: Wax Chamber
zones.description: A sheltered cavity immediately behind the parapet entrance, rough brick walls, overlapping sheets of wax comb, open honey-filled cells, a small horizontal comb ledge, and a narrow entrance slit admitting daylight

baseline.weather: clear, dry weather with a light breeze
baseline.lighting: hard outdoor sunlight with short shadows; dim reflected daylight inside the hive, strongest beside its entrance.

breakdown.logline: After a careless man stamps on an ant, the ant swells and he shrinks, forcing him through a terrifying insect chase and lethal traffic before a windborne escape on a bee leads to an unexpectedly delicious refuge.

beats.summary: The man's stamp triggers the ant's explosive enlargement and his own shrinking, throwing him backward
His shrinking finishes, and ordinary pedestrians now tower above him like giants
A cockroach pursues him, turning bewilderment into desperate flight
He escapes across the road through narrowly separated moving tires
A gust delivers him onto a flying bee, turning the city into a first-person aerial journey
Inside the bee's hive, he tastes honey and discovers that his strange refuge is pleasurable

subjects.name: Man
subjects.appearance: slim build, long limbs, short dark hair, light-gray hooded jacket, charcoal trousers, pale thick-soled sneakers
signature_features: a narrow silhouette topped by a bulky raised hood collar, with oversized-looking sneaker soles recognizable from any angle.

subjects.name: Ant
subjects.appearance: tiny dark insect with a three-part body, narrow waist, six long angular legs, and paired antennae
signature_features: sharply pinched waist and disproportionately long, widely spread legs.

subjects.name: Pedestrians
subjects.appearance: one tall and slender in a charcoal knee-length coat carrying an open pale sun umbrella; one shorter and broad-bodied in a light-gray jacket and dark trousers
signature_features: contrasting tall-narrow and short-broad silhouettes, with the umbrella's broad circular outline visible from above or below.

subjects.name: Cockroach
subjects.appearance: approximately four centimeters long, nearly black flattened oval body, six spiny legs, and exceptionally long antennae
signature_features: broad low body with antennae extending farther forward than its body length.

subjects.name: Cars
subjects.appearance: one pale-gray and one charcoal, both long, low-bodied sedans with rounded roofs, broad wheel spacing, and dark tires
signature_features: low elongated proportions and strongly contrasting body values remain recognizable from side, rear, or above.

subjects.name: Bee
subjects.appearance: approximately eighteen millimeters long, thick pale-gray thoracic fur, a dark-and-light banded abdomen, six dark legs, and long translucent wings
signature_features: bulky furry thorax, tapered banded abdomen, and wings projecting beyond the body's width.

spec.shot_name: Man stamping Ant and toppling backward

subject_states.subject: Man
subject_states.state: Reduced to approximately ninety centimeters tall; his clothing and sneakers have shrunk proportionally.

subject_states.subject: Ant
subject_states.state: Enlarged to approximately ninety centimeters long, with its legs braced across multiple paving joints.

spec.backdrop: Concrete slabs, gritty joints, the raised curb, and a brick storefront base with a recessed doorway.
spec.action: Man's stamping sneaker presses against Ant's swollen abdomen as the insect rises beneath it. His hips drop backward, his supporting foot slips, and both arms fling outward.
spec.emotion: Abrupt shock at an ordinary gesture becoming physically impossible.
spec.transition: Hard cut to pavement-level scale, completing the reversal of size.
